english.title: Provisional licence supervisor fail to give own name / address - road
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe was supervising **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, while driving a motor vehicle, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) at a time when

(A)_[an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(B)_[an offence was suspected of having been committed by the said licence holder in relation to the use of the vehicle]_

on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being required by a constable failed to give your name and address.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) For the comparable offence in relation to an accident only in a public place see H118
(ii) This offence wording does not relate to invalid carriages.
(iii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) This offence was extended to include 'other public place' by the The Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) Regulations 2000 - S.I. 726/2000 refers.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was suspected of supervising **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, who was driving **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) at a time when

(A)_[an accident occurred]_
(B)_[an offence was suspected of having been committed by **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..) in relation to the use of the VEHICLE]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). the defendant failed to give **(..SPECIFY HIS OR HER..) name and address to a police constable when requested to do so.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
